headline: Growth cools sequentially, still surges year over year
summary_short: Credo's quarter ended around fiscal year-end (May 2, 2026) showed revenue of $437.0M, up 7.4% q/q and 157.0% y/y, and net income of $169.1M, up 362.2% y/y, as AI-linked AEC cable demand continued to ramp at hyperscale customers.
summary_long: Final-quarter revenue was $437.0M, up 7.4% q/q and 157.0% y/y; gross margin held near 68.2% (-0.3ppt q/q, +1.0ppt y/y). Net income reached $169.1M (+362.2% y/y) and EBITDA $172.1M (+306.7% y/y). For the full fiscal year (ended May 2, 2026), revenue nearly tripled to $1.3B from $436.8M, with margin up 320bp to 68.0%, driven by AEC cable unit-shipment ramp at hyperscale customers - over 99% of the annual increase per the filing. R&D and SG&A both rose on higher stock-based compensation and headcount. Cash plus short-term investments ended at $1.43B versus $408.2M a year ago, after acquiring Hyperlume and Comira. No guidance or dividend disclosed.
